# Zenskar

Zenskar is a Software Development company. Zenskar is an AI-native revenue automation platform that provides billing, RevRec automation, and analytics services for real-world complexity. The platform allows agents to execute, humans to supervise, and is designed to be a zero-touch finance. Zenskar employs 116 people (+50.6% YoY, +39 people) and has an annual revenue of $1M, founded in 2022. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including India, United States, Canada, Sweden, and United Arab Emirates).

## About

Zenskar is an AI-native revenue automation that solves real-world complexity. Our vision – Zero-touch finance - where agents execute and humans supervise. Result, finance teams to scale business without scaling headcount.

Talk to Zenskar AI like a colleague. Ask questions, give instructions, get insights, and approve decisions through natural conversation without any technical complexity. 

The platform offers unlimited pricing flexibility to set up subscriptions, usage-based billing, or custom contracts without requiring developers. 

With 200+ plug-and-play integrations and comprehensive migration support, companies can implement Zenskar in weeks rather than months. 

Let your finance teams collaborate with AI instead of drowning in spreadsheets or waiting for developers, increasing efficiency without expanding headcount.
